attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `ydhX`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99% of them, at 0.06 bits.

**The rest of the window is fork and variable columns.** Columns 1 to 79 are carried by 63 to 87%, 74 persistent and 5 shell, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 6% of calls. A branch of 58 families runs through columns 1 to 58, a parallel path carried in 11 to 13%. The `rsxE` to `rsxA` genes, columns 38 to 43, are [[electron transport]].

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 99 against 95%, and hesitates less there, 0.06 against 0.18 bits. Its most hesitant column, 17, `lhr`, is a fork column, at 0.53 bits.

**The window ends on fork and variable columns.** Column 79, `ynfL`, is carried by 68% of chromosomes. A branch of 3 families runs through columns 67 to 69, carried in 10%.

**Across the window it names 95% of genes**, 0.18 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 2.18 against 0.14 bits, and names fewer genes, 37% against 96%.

label: ydhX
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the ydhX window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ydhX, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,072 to 2,151 from dnaA. Read in 531 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ydhX once); 42,480 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.18 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 39,257 calls, named 98%, 0.11 bits; shell 3,013 calls, named 66%, 0.76 bits; cloud 210 calls, named 1%, 3.70 bits. Outside an RGP 41,702 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 778 calls, named 37%, 2.18 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 70 fork, 9 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (2.18 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (37% against 96%); 778 of the 42,480 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 17 (lhr, a fork column) 0.53 bits, RGP 0%; column 16 (grxD, a fork column) 0.49 bits, RGP 0%; column 55 (uidB, a fork column) 0.46 bits, RGP 6%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 99%, 0.06 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 95%, 0.18 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 17, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: ydhX "4Fe-4S dicluster domain-containing…". named 99%; 0.06 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 63-87%, 74 P, 5 S, RGP 0-6%. named 67-100% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 71, named 67%; most hesitant at column 17, 0.53 bits.
